hotels.title: Byron Bay Eco-Luxury Retreat Amidst Tranquil Rainforest with Indulgent Spa & Forest-Themed Restaurant
hotels.description: Celebrate a harmony of nature and contemporary elegance at this five-star eco-conscious sanctuary nestled amid 45 acres of lush subtropical rainforest in the heart of Byron Bay. Immerse yourself in the serenity of verdant foliage, savour the flavours of locally sourced cuisine at Forest which boasts an onsite herb garden and offers biodynamic wines and rejuvenate your senses at the world-class Eléme Spa. If you wish to venture out, Byron Bay's vibrant town centre and the renowned beaches of Tallow and Pass are a short drive away.

hotels.title: Boutique Byron Bay Coastal Escape with Daily Drinks, Outdoor Pool & Spa
hotels.description: The Bower Byron Bay brings boutique design to Byron's coastal scene, minutes from the beach and the town's thriving restaurant strip. This reimagined boutique resort wraps Byron Bay's soulful coastal lifestyle in a layer of effortless New York-style sophistication. At the heart of it all sits the outdoor heated magnesium pool, surrounded by lush greenery. Unwind at The Bower Hotel Spa with an expansive spa menu, including soothing facials and relaxing full-body massages. Mornings might start with a cycle to the Thursday farmers' markets or a stroll down to the beach for a sunrise swim, before rolling back for an afternoon by the pool. With local breweries, Cape Byron's iconic lighthouse and endless stretches of sand all within easy reach, so you're perfectly positioned to explore Byron's best - or simply claim a sunlounger and let the world slow down around you.
